mapper.sql: select p.product_id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.image_url, p.barcode, p.status, p.sort, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, fs.sale_id as flash_sale_id, fs.flash_price as flash_price, fs.end_time as flash_end_time, (fs.stock_limit - fs.sold_count) as flash_stock_left, ga.activity_id as ga_activity_id, ga.title as ga_title, ga.min_group_size as ga_min_group_size, ga.end_time as ga_end_time, gt.min_price as ga_best_price from mall_product p left join mall_flash_sale fs on fs.product_id = p.product_id and fs.status = '1' and now() between fs.start_time and fs.end_time left join mall_group_activity ga on ga.product_id = p.product_id and ga.status = '0' and now() between ga.start_time and ga.end_time left join ( select activity_id, min(price) as min_price from mall_group_tier group by activity_id ) gt on gt.activity_id = ga.activity_id
mapper.select:
and p.del_flag = '0' AND p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') AND p.status = #{status} AND fs.sale_id IS NOT NULL AND ga.activity_id IS NOT NULL AND p.stock > 0
order by
COALESCE(fs.flash_price, p.price) ASC COALESCE(fs.flash_price, p.price) DESC p.create_time DESC p.sort ASC, p.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: insert into mall_product(category_id, name, description, price, stock, image_url, barcode, status, sort, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values(#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{imageUrl}, #{barcode}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update mall_product set del_flag = '2' where product_id = #{productId}
